**The Mission: Building the OS for Indian Real Estate** 




 As a Core Backend Engineer, your code will be the source of truth for real estate transactions worth crores. You won't build features in isolation — you'll build systems where everything connects.  Kafka (event bus), Hatchet \\+ RabbitMQ (workflow orchestration)

 Firebase

 SigNoz \\+ ClickHouse (traces, metrics, logs)

* Solid backend experience building scalable, distributed systems.
